item.title: Anthropic CEO to AI companies: Fulfil your cancer promise, rather than blaming me
item.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei believes public negativity towards AI stems from a deep crisis of trust. He argues that genuine breakthroughs, not marketing, will rebuild credibility with ordinary people. Amodei stated that AI firms must deliver tangible benefits to regain public confidence. He also discussed AI regulation, favoring oversight that decentralizes power. Anthropic is focusing on biological and medical advancements to prove its value.
